title: AttendX
description: A cross-platform mobile app for tracking student attendance at schools and training programs, with real-time reporting for administrators.
challenge: Schools were using paper registers or spreadsheets for attendance. Data was siloed, reports were manual, and there was no real-time visibility into who was present.
solution: Built a React Native app (iOS + Android) with QR-code-based check-in, real-time Supabase backend, admin dashboard, automated absence alerts, and export to PDF/Excel reports.
